title: The Sixteenth Homecoming
author: Ivo Halloran
blurb: Oscar Ravensworth, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
